quotations.old_english: Swá we ofer cald wæter ceólum líðan, geond sídne sǽ flódwudu fergen
quotations.english: as if we journey in vessels over the cold water, convey our ships through the wide sea

source_text: flód-wudu; m. Flood-wood, a ship; m&a-short;r&i-long;num lignum, n&a-long;vis :-- Swá we ofer cald wæter ceólum líðan, geond sídne sǽ flódwudu fergen as if we journey in vessels over the cold water, convey our ships through the wide sea, Exon. 20a; Th. 53, 21; Cri. 854.
